info.description:
REST API of the learning management system: courses, lessons, quizzes, certificates, payments and reports.
Every answer is {"success": true, "data": ...} or {"success": false, "error": {"code", "message", "fields"}}.
Log in with POST /auth/login, then click "Authorize" and enter: Bearer <access_token>.
